description: Stripe objects, event destination and variable names ZeroAgent billing expects in each environment. Names and shapes only: no amount, no Price id, no key, no secret and no object id of any kind is recorded here.

separation.rule: Sandbox and live are separate Stripe environments with separate keys, signing secrets, Product ids, portal configurations, databases and event destinations. A deployment is configured for exactly one. An event or object whose livemode differs from STRIPE_EXPECT_LIVE_MODE is refused.
separation.sandboxDeployments: Vercel Preview and staging, with a dedicated staging database

product.name: ZeroAgent Premium
product.notes: Never replaced for a price change. Stays active.

price.currentSale: The Product's default_price, resolved at request time. Its amount is entered only in Stripe, at creation, by the owner's approval.
price.notes: No Price id is configured anywhere. A price change adds a Price to the same Product, sets it as default_price, and archives the previous one (docs/STRIPE-SETUP.md).

origins.sandbox: a stable staging origin, chosen when the sandbox is provisioned

STRIPE_API_KEY.meaning: Restricted runtime key of this environment's mode (customers, Checkout and portal sessions, subscription and invoice reads)

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.meaning: Signing secret of this environment's event destination

STRIPE_PREMIUM_PRODUCT_ID.meaning: Id of this environment's Premium Product

STRIPE_PORTAL_CONFIGURATION_ID.meaning: Id of this environment's portal configuration

STRIPE_ACCOUNT_ID.meaning: Id of the ZeroAgent Stripe account; scopes the event inbox and unique indexes

STRIPE_EXPECT_LIVE_MODE.meaning: "true" in live, "false" in sandbox; never defaulted

BILLING_BASE_URL.meaning: Origin only; exact Origin match for mutating routes. Optional, defaults to https://zeroagenthq.com

runtimeCatalog.audit: billingAudit, append-only: actor, reason, time, previous and new value
